description: Dr. Quintard Taylor, founder of BlackPast.org, is giving a virtual lecture via Zoom. This will be a truly unique campaign event that you won’t want to miss (and I’m not just saying that because he’s my dad!)Titled “Politics and Protest: Exploring the History of African Americans in Washington Politics since 1890.” This will be a special opportunity to learn about our history in Washington state. And it’s especially timely as I put my name on the ballot this year.Join us on Thursday, May 28th, 20
